name: Pelle P
verdict: Swedish clothing brand of PPY Production AB, which is part of the Saelma & Co AB group; private owners, nothing found.
note: Official Clothing Supplier of Artemis SailGP (pellepetterson.com press release, 2026). The brand's parent chain (PPY Production AB -> Saelma & Co AB) is private; no state or fund, nothing found.
